lines.text: ... are coming back into a physical state where you need some refreshment.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Yeah, Kenzo kind of looks up at you and is very grateful, grabs some water, drinks. "Thank you, friend. I think you helped save my life."

lines.speaker: Riswynn
lines.text: Well, we all contributed. You're welcome.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Well, we're glad to have you back, Kenzo.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Well, thank y—

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: I'll admit... Say again, sorry.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Oh, go ahead, go ahead. Finish what you were saying, Seeker.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Oh, I admit I'm curious, based on my, as you know, geological interests, how it was that you were able to shake the ground around you, if indeed you were causing that somehow.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: The ground was shaking around me?

lines.speaker: Riswynn
lines.text: Oh, yes.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: So it seemed while you were meditating earlier, or it looked like you were meditating.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: I think I need to spend the evening processing what has occurred, but what were these things, you know? Where are they now, those creatures? I just kinda look at... I'm shredded. [laughs] You know what I mean? It's like I'm just—

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: ... just been shredded, you know.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: You took a lot of bites.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: What were those things? What the hell was that?

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: I think they were creatures from some other world.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: These mouth creatures, I've seen a drawing of them in a book. Many years ago—well, actually, it's not that many years ago—[laughs] I read a book about—

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, not that long.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: ... about creatures that can come from darker planes than this one. But they have to have been summoned here somehow by powerful magic.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: This is... You know, as Kenzo's talking and drinking, you can see him in a way kind of coming out of his trance a little bit. It's like his eyes start changing back to normal, the normal color from before, and he's sort of just kind of getting back into himself, and he's like, "This... I don't know what this means, but this is, this is... I... This is... It's hard to process everything that's happening right now, what the implications of this are."

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Indeed. Well, we have a journey ahead of us to puzzle things out.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: What are your plans for the evening to prepare?

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Well, I think I showed you the little booklet, my humble sheaf of drawings that I've now bound up into Legendary Staff of Kenzo, my account of your feats in the games.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: [laughs]

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: I was thinking I might spend a few hours tonight drawing.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Eric, I think at some point I'm gonna actually need to see the Legendary Staff of Kenzo, like, in real life.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: [laughs]

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: I'll work on it. I did actually just destroy the binding earlier today, so let's put that back together. Yeah, so I'm gonna make some drawings. I think we all need to get some rest.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Yeah. I think that's right. Tim, would it be easier for me to find new clothing someplace?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yeah. I mean, you probably have a spare set of clothing anyway.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Yeah, spare set of clothing. Perfect.

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: I'm gonna just, before it gets too late, look around and see if there's any tracks.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Okay. Make a survival check.

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: With a six. 23.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yeah, there are tracks leading north, and you can distinguish the hyena creatures and the mouths. They seem to have come together traveling from the north, but then split when they hit this building, and the mouths went right, and the hyena creatures went left.

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: What time of day is it?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Evening now. The sun is setting.

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: I wonder what those mouth guys were headed towards.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: But you can see... I mean, you can get a read on where the tracks are leading, and—

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: ... you're pretty sure you can pick up the trail in the morning, unless it... If it rains overnight or something, that would be bad.

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: Right. Right, right.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: But it almost never rains, so.

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: Right. Right. Okay.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: It's a desert.

lines.speaker: Delwath
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: I'm just gonna get a change of clothes and then go meditate at the oasis tonight.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Okay, okay, so as you all settle into your evening, preparing for your journey in the morning, quiet settles over the town, interrupted by the sort of clangs and bustling noises of horses being packed, of saddlebags being loaded, food stores being emptied out of the inn.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And when you wake at first light in the morning, a huge, a huge horde has gathered, probably 1,000 people or so, on at least 1,500 horses, sort of stretching to the west as people begin to head out of the village for safety.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Some moving quickly ahead, some, like the halflings, moving a bit slower behind. But Havdar and about 25 troops that he's managed to recruit here, as well as the survivors of the retreat of the refugees, are keeping a close watch on the rear. And as the town empties to the west, you turn, looking north to your destination, the rising sun casting long shadows as you pick up the tracks again and begin to head north. And that is where we'll stop for tonight.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Awesome.

lines.speaker: Kenzo
lines.text: Awesome.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Thanks, Tim.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: Seeker
lines.text: Thanks for join—
